query: 客户隐私保护政策 客户隐私保护政策 衡量企业在个人信息收集、使用、存储和共享方面的治理水平。重点考察“最小必要”原则的落地、用户授权机制、数据留存期限、第三方共享管理及隐私安全事件的应急响应。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的隐私政策，严格遵循“最小必要”原则；建立了动态授权与撤回机制；明确了数据留存与销毁时限；对第三方数据共享有严苛的审计要求，并披露了具体的隐私漏洞响应与补偿机制。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的隐私政策及用户协议，包含基础的收集与使用告知，具备数据加密等保护措施，但缺乏深度的第三方穿透管理、明确的留存期限或用户撤回授权的操作指南。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式隐私政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视信息安全”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：隐私保护机制覆盖 >80% 的业务线、APP/平台终端及经营地区，且通过了相关的外部审计（如 ISO 27701）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心 APP 具备政策而其他子业务线存在盲区，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 隐私政策 个人信息保护 最小必要 用户授权 数据留存 第三方共享 隐私事件响应 撤回同意 个人信息保护法 PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 privacy policy personal data protection data minimization user consent data retention third-party sharing privacy incident response PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 是否有正式客户/用户隐私政策或用户协议？ 是否披露个人信息收集和使用告知、最小必要原则及用户授权机制？ 用户能否撤回同意、注销账户、访问、更正或删除个人信息？ 是否采用数据加密、脱敏或访问控制？ 数据留存与销毁时限如何规定？ 第三方共享及SDK如何审核和约束？ 隐私事件响应、补偿、外部认证及覆盖范围是什么？

results.text: The Group strictly abides by the laws and regulations of the PRC government, including the 'Labour Law' and the 'Labour Contract Law'. When the human resources department conducts recruitment work, it shall strictly verify the personal identity of the applicant and perform background checks well to avoid child labour. Employees at production bases are recruited of their own accord. The staff induction process is carried out in line with corporate systems and procedures where no child labour is employed. The ages of all employees satisfy the requirements of local laws. The phenomenon of forced labour does not exist. If any illegal employment of child labour or forced labour is discovered, the Group will immediately terminate the employment contract, identify the cause and pursue responsibility, and impose appropriate penalties on the employee and related person in violation.

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.

results.section: Energy use/water efficiency targets and management / A2: Use of Resources
results.text: The water consumption within the plants is mainly due to the water replenishment of the recirculating cooling system for the equipment and the domestic water consumption by our staffs. Recirculating cooling water, mainly the equipment cooling water, is pumped into the production water supply pipeline for reuse after cooling in a cooling tower. The domestic water consumption (mainly washing water, flushing water for offices, and recirculating cooling water within the plants) is recycled and not discharged. The environmental hygiene department regularly collects the domestic wastewater for centralised treatment at sewage treatment plants.

Energy use/water efficiency targets and management / A2: Use of Resources

[Content]
The water consumption within the plants is mainly due to the water replenishment of the recirculating cooling system for the equipment and the domestic water consumption by our staffs. Recirculating cooling water, mainly the equipment cooling water, is pumped into the production water supply pipeline for reuse after cooling in a cooling tower. The domestic water consumption (mainly washing water, flushing water for offices, and recirculating cooling water within the plants) is recycled and not discharged. The environmental hygiene department regularly collects the domestic wastewater for centralised treatment at sewage treatment plants.
